name: Studio Composition Runtime
purpose: Canonical, dependency-free (GSAP 3.12.5 core only) runtime for HyperFrames compositions: format-aware layout variables, seeded randomness, path drawing and morphing, text splitting and typography motion, masks and scene transitions, depth/parallax, rhythm helpers, textures, reusable compositions and five style systems. Projects vendor a locked copy under src/_studio/.
capabilities: studio-core.js: format, safe areas, seeded rng/noise, timeline registration, scene show/hide/crossfade/cut
studio-draw.js: stroke draw, line art, hand-drawn lines, blobs, waves, morph, wobble, particles
studio-type.js: accessible split, mask rise, cascade, tracking, weight, typewriter, highlight, underline, counters
studio-motion.js: reveal/wipe/iris/push/shape-cover/liquid/match-cut transitions, depth camera, assembly, rhythm grid, grain
studio-compositions.js: title card, item list, step header, end card, captions
studio-base.css + styles/*.css: tokens, type scale per format, layout primitives, style systems
studio-rig.js (1.4.0): articulated character rig (FK, contact anchors, IK, followers, cycles)
studio-rig.js (1.5.0): derive hook, attributes computed from each solved pose and tweened per move sample
kits/fitness/sculpt.js (1.5.0): Cobalt Sculpt Tibi, male and female (see shared-fitness-kit)
studio-rig.js (1.6.0): per-joint foreshortening (pose.f) for views toward or away from the camera
kits/fitness/exercises.js (1.6.0): 12 upper-body exercises on Tibi with flat-plane equipment; classic tibi.js retired

kits/fitness/tibi3d.js + exercises3d.js + vendor/three.min.js (1.7.0): Tibi in real 3D (skinned figure, muscles that never pop, free camera, pure-function-of-time motion tracks) with curl, bench press and lateral raise; QA by scripts/rig3d-check.js, rig3d-stills.py, motion-continuity.py

1.8.0: 3D lower body (squat and knees-blocked squat, hip thrust, standing and seated calf raise; glute, adductor, soleus; heel lift; chest-frame arm IK; stage.views split screens; muscles under clothing warm through a deep role colour) and kits/fitness/film3d.js (overlays, pins, camera shots, bar panels for narrated 3D films)

1.9.0: anatomy 1.0 (one skin: surface activation, cutaways, isolation, skeleton), phase machine per 3D exercise, scene library, instructional overlays, frame-0 title cards; the dumbbell-press figure-id fix

installation.instructions: python3 scripts/studio.py sync <slug> copies it into projects/<slug>/src/_studio/ with studio.lock.json.

compatibility.notes: Self-test (tests/test-studio-runtime.py) passes in Playwright Chromium on Windows: determinism, backward seeking and seek-order independence. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames. Runtime 1.4.0 (2026-11-08) adds the rig engine and the fitness kit; rendered with HyperFrames on the M2 host in projects/how-muscles-grow. Runtime 1.5.0 (2026-11-09) adds the Cobalt Sculpt Tibi and the rig's derive hook; verified in headless Chrome, not yet in a HyperFrames film render.

licensing.notes: Original workspace code; no third-party code copied. GSAP is loaded separately (see library record).

security.notes: Runs inside the render browser only; no network calls of its own.

approval_evidence: tests/test-studio-runtime.py PASS; masala-chai-recipe frame review PASS in three formats (2026-10-30). Promote after HyperFrames renders on the M2 host.
